original_test_intent: Verify the complete SYSTEM_CONFIG key/value baseline across authoritative permitted in-band, out-of-band and BMC Web configuration views against a versioned platform recipe without changing configuration.
original_method: Bind configuration keys to the exact SUT/BMC/firmware recipe; collect complete read-only key paths, types, values, defaults, hidden/disabled state and dependencies from authoritative interfaces; compare all views and record mismatches while preserving current configuration and logs. The source sensor-based method remains an unresolved defect.
manual_activity: The owner defines the SYSTEM_CONFIG recipe and authoritative interfaces and resolves the sensor wording and criteria 3–78; an operator reviews hidden/default Web fields, then the owner decides the verdict.
required_inputs: Authoritative read-only IB and OOB endpoints per key
BMC Web/API field map including hidden and disabled values
Redaction policy, protected access and freshness rules
Source sensor-method disposition and criteria 3–78 decision
safety_requirements: Use read-only endpoints and protected credentials
Never save, apply, reset or write configuration
Redact secrets and sensitive values while retaining equality evidence
Do not treat SDR, Sensor list or a CONFIG substring as configuration proof
Stop on mismatch, unknown key/type, unsafe value, dependency conflict, wrong firmware or identity
agent_execution_scope: Verify the unique source and exact recipe applicability
Collect only approved read-only configuration views
Normalize complete keys, types, values, defaults, dependencies and save-state
Report mismatches without remediation and retain the source method conflict
Perform no config write, source correction, criteria invention or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve the recipe, key inventory and authoritative interfaces
Resolve whether sensor-list wording is a copied defect and define replacement evidence
Resolve criteria gap and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `sensor get 'Check Config - SYSTEM_CONFIG'` invents a sensor and cannot validate configuration; head-limited SDR output is also unrelated and incomplete.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use approved read-only configuration endpoints to export every recipe key from IB/OOB and Web/API, then normalize and diff type, value, default, visibility and dependency with redaction.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source's CONFIG sensor searches, Web Sensor list, SPEC wording, Config-Check and 3/0-minute values are preserved as conflicts rather than silently rewritten.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Compare a versioned typed recipe to authoritative read-only exports from each required surface and capture hidden/default/dependency state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Uses configuration evidence instead of unrelated sensor data, without applying changes.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Sensor presence cannot prove settings, defaults or dependencies; the original procedure currently leaves the named configuration intent uncovered.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Read endpoints can expose secrets or omit hidden/default values; redaction and an approved completeness map are required.

project_override_considerations: If the owner declares SYSTEM_CONFIG to be a real OEM sensor record rather than configuration inventory, the exact record ID and semantics must be provided and the config intent must be separately dispositioned; this review does not guess either interpretation.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and source method/intent mismatch record
Versioned recipe, firmware compatibility and complete key/type/default/dependency inventory
Redacted raw read-only IB/OOB configuration exports with timestamps/exits
Complete Web/API configuration capture including hidden/disabled/default/save-state fields
Per-key normalized diff, source and criteria decisions, no-write/no-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item names SYSTEM_CONFIG, but Procedure and Criteria demand sensor lists and sensor readings; no authoritative configuration interface or key baseline is defined. Criteria jump from 2 to 79, and DeepSeek further invents a sensor target.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A safe static review can record the defect; execution becomes possible when the recipe and authoritative read-only interfaces are supplied.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2035 Wistron-BMC-01054-V002: decide whether SYSTEM_CONFIG is a configuration inventory or an OEM sensor record; if configuration, provide the versioned key/type/value/default/dependency recipe and authoritative read-only IB/OOB/Web interfaces, disposition the copied Sensor-list/reading wording, and confirm whether Criteria 1, 2, 79 is only misnumbered or Criteria 3–78 are missing.

review_improvement: Exposes the method-versus-intent defect, requires a complete typed configuration baseline and prevents sensor evidence or any save/apply action from standing in for a config diff.
independent_technical_reasoning: Configuration validity is a comparison of named settings, types, values and dependencies, whereas SDR contains sensor data records. Even if a CONFIG-named OEM record exists, it cannot by itself prove the complete SYSTEM_CONFIG baseline. Because changing a setting could affect the entire SUT, the only safe executable scope is versioned read-only export and diff after the owner resolves the source identity.
